column2: Type a tag and press Enter

column1: Yerel kameralari uzak oturuma yonlendirir. Sunucu Windows 10 1803 / Server 2019 veya yenisi olmali.
column2: Redirects local cameras to the remote session. The server must be Windows 10 1803 / Server 2019 or later.
Do not connect if verification fails
Send Windows keys to the remote session

column1: Kapaliyken Windows tusu ve Win+Shift+S yerel bilgisayara etki eder (yalniz tam ekranda uzak oturuma gider).
column2: When off, the Windows key and Win+Shift+S act on the local computer (they reach the remote session only in full screen).

column1: Bos birakilirsa dogrudan baglanilir. Gateway yukaridaki kullanici adi ve parolayi kullanir.
column2: If left empty, connects directly. The gateway uses the user name and password above.

column1: Kayitli parola var. Degistirmek icin yenisini yazin, dokunmazsaniz korunur.
column2: A password is saved. Type a new one to change it, or leave it blank to keep it.
If no password is saved, Windows asks for it when connecting.

column1: Kayitli parolalarin da disa aktarilmasi icin bir parola belirleyin. Dosya bu parolayla sifrelenir (AES-256), ice aktarirken ayni parola sorulur.
column2: Set a password to export saved passwords as well. The file is encrypted with this password (AES-256), and the same password is asked for when importing.

column1: Bos birakirsaniz baglantilar parolasiz disa aktarilir.\nBu parola hicbir yerde saklanmaz - kaybederseniz dosyadaki parolalar kurtarilamaz.
column2: If left empty, connections are exported without passwords.\nThis password is not stored anywhere - if you lose it, the passwords in the file cannot be recovered.

column1: Bu dosya sifrelenmis parolalar iceriyor. Disa aktarirken belirlediginiz parolayi girin.
column2: This file contains encrypted passwords. Enter the password you set when exporting.

column1: Bu parola hicbir yerde saklanmaz - kaybederseniz dosyadaki parolalar kurtarilamaz.
column2: This password is not stored anywhere - if you lose it, the passwords in the file cannot be recovered.
Show session preview in the list

column1: Yeni baglanti olustururken bu degerler onceden doldurulur.
column2: These values are prefilled when you create a new connection.

column1: Sunucu durum API anahtarinizi girin. Anahtar girilirse listede sunucuda kimin bagli oldugu gorunur.
column2: Enter your server status API key. With a key, the list shows who is connected to each server.

column1: Anahtari bos birakirsaniz sunucu durumu takibi devre disi kalir.
column2: Leave the key empty to disable server status tracking.
You are using the latest version.

column1: VNC sunucusu parola istiyorsa burada kaydedin; baglanirken sorulmaz.
column2: If the VNC server requires a password, save it here; you will not be asked when connecting.

column1: Anahtar sifreliyse parolasini yazin; degilse bos birakin.
column2: If the key is encrypted, enter its passphrase; otherwise leave it empty.
Save the password to sign in over SSH.

column1: RDP, VNC ve SSH baglantilari tek pencerede, sekmeler halinde.
column2: RDP, VNC and SSH connections in one window, as tabs.
